english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's trustworthiness or whether others believe them.

examples.english: I have always had credibility because I do what I say.
examples.traditional: 我一向都好有信用，講得出做得到。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 jau5 seon3 jung6 gong2 dak1 ceot1 zou6 dak1 dou3

english.note: Use this for creditworthiness or confidence that payment will be made, rather than personal emotional trust.
